item.title: ००५ रावणप्रासादवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Hanuma sees the denizens of city of Lanka rendered beautiful by the glorious moon, Hanuma also become anxious had not become to able to find Seetha.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी का रावणके अन्तःपुरमें घर-घरमें सीताको ढूँढ़ना और उन्हें न देखकर दुःखी होना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Hanūmān beholds the full moon risen in mid-heaven, pouring forth a canopy of moonlight, swelling the ocean, and shining with the splendor of Mandara, a caged swan, and a lion.

item.title: ००६ अन्तःपुरवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Hanuma moves about the city of Lanka, going from one house to another in search of mother Seetha. He finds amazing wealth and riches abounding in that city of Ravana. He finally enters the huge house of Ravana.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी का रावण तथा अन्यान्य राक्षसोंके घरोंमें सीताजीकी खोज करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Moving swiftly at will through seven-storied palaces, Hanūmān approaches Rāvaṇa’s sun-walled royal precinct, guarded like a lion-filled forest and thronged with mahouts and ivory-decked chariots.

item.title: ००७ हनुमता पुष्पकविमानदर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Hanuma continues his search for mother Seetha in Ravana’s inner city. He sees the aerial plane Pushpaka in Ravana’s building.

भागसूचना
  1. रावणके भवन एवं पुष्पक विमानका वर्णन
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Hanūmān beholds Rāvaṇa’s cluster of mansions with cat’s-eye and golden lattices like lightning-wrapped monsoon clouds, moon-halls, weapon-galleries, and a supreme palace like heaven on earth.

item.title: ००८ पुष्पकविमानवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

This chapter describes Pushpaka in glorious and amazing detail.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी के द्वारा पुनः पुष्पक विमानका दर्शन
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Standing in the midst of Rāvaṇa’s palace, Hanūmān beholds the great aerial car Puṣpaka—acclaimed by Viśvakarman himself, stationed in the wind-path, and moving at the mere wish of the mind.

item.title: ००९ रावणान्तःपुरवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

This chapter further describes the inner buildings of Ravana’s house. Hanuma passess through a hall filled with Ravana’s wives.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी का रावणके श्रेष्ठ भवन पुष्पक विमान तथा रावणके रहनेकी सुन्दर हवेलीको देखकर उसके भीतर सोयी हुई सहस्रों सुन्दरी स्त्रियोंका अवलोकन करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Searching for wide-eyed Vaidehī, Hanumān circuits Rāvaṇa’s vast central palace, guarded by four- and three-tusked elephants and filled with abducted princesses.

item.title: ०१० हनुमता रावणान्तःपुरप्रवेशः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this Chapter Hanuma has first glimpse of Ravana in his house. He also observes various wives of Ravana sleeping in the house. He sees Mandodari and thinks her to be Seetha.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी का अन्तःपुरमें सोये हुए रावण तथा गाढ़ निद्रामें पड़ी हुई उसकी स्त्रियोंको देखना तथा मन्दोदरीको सीता समझकर प्रसन्न होना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Gazing around the hall, Hanumān beholds Rāvaṇa’s crystal couch-platform, its moon-white canopy, and the sun-bright golden bedstead fanned with yak-tail whisks.

item.title: ०११ हनुमता रावणान्तःपुरे सीतान्वेषणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

Realizing that the woman he saw at Ravana’s house was not Seetha, Hanuma begins to search again for Seetha.

भागसूचना
  1. वह सीता नहीं है—ऐसा निश्चय होनेपर हनुमान् जी का पुनः अन्तःपुरमें और उसकी पानभूमिमें सीताका पता लगाना, उनके मनमें धर्मलोपकी आशंका और स्वतः उसका निवारण होना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Dismissing his mistaken impression that Mandodarī is Sītā, Hanumān reflects on Jānakī’s unwavering fidelity to Rāma and resumes searching the banquet hall among Rāvaṇa’s slumbering consorts.

item.title: ०१२ हनूमन्निर्वेदः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Murali Krishnamurthy Kopalle Murthy - Intro

Book V : Sundara Kanda - Book Of Beauty

In this chapter Hanuma gets discouraging thoughts about Seetha. He thinks that Seetha might be dead. He thus gets into depression for a moment.

भागसूचना
  1. सीताके मरणकी आशंकासे हनुमान् जी का शिथिल होना, फिर उत्साहका आश्रय लेकर अन्य स्थानोंमें उनकी खोज करना और कहीं भी पता न लगनेसे पुनः उनका चिन्तित होना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Searching the creeper-bowers, painted galleries, and night-pavilions in vain, Hanumān fears that chaste Sītā has been slain by Rāvaṇa or died of terror, rendering return to Sugrīva impossible.
